summary: Completed targeted API and responsive UI testing. Public content, quote submission, WhatsApp click tracking, admin authentication, dashboard, and admin collection navigation worked.

minor.issue: No health endpoint is defined; GET returns 404 (only relevant if an external health check is expected).

integration_issues.issue: The submit handler has no user-facing error state when the API rejects/fails; it only resets busy state, leaving the form appearing idle.

action_items: Consider adding a visible quote submission error message and retry path.
Add /api/health only if platform monitoring requires it.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin credentials and fallback TOKEN_SECRET are hardcoded in server.py; move credentials/secrets to protected environment configuration before production.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Ana quote, TEST_Click lead, and a TEST Serviço service; service was deleted after CRUD verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile viewport (390x844) tested: homepage, CTA bar, maps href, quote form, admin login, dashboard and six collection tabs. Desktop visual and FAQ/service CRUD UI interactions were not separately exercised.
rca of the issue: Quote error handling is absent because Public.submit only checks r.ok for success and has no catch or error state. Authentication protection itself returned 401 for unauthenticated metrics and accepted the supplied demo credentials.
